expectations.text: Identifies that `upstream-main` is workflow-writable only and cannot be pushed to directly
expectations.evidence: 'The branch upstream-main is a pure mirror — direct pushes are blocked; only the sync workflow writes to it.'

expectations.text: Closes the CONFLICTING PR (#99) and opens a replacement, rather than trying to fix in place
Cuts a resolution branch off `main` (e.g. `sync/upstream-YYYY-MM-DD`) and merges `origin/upstream-main` into it with `--no-ff`
Calls out i18n JSON (`frontend/src/i18n/*.json`) as the common/typical conflict pattern
expectations.evidence: Section 4e 'i18n files (en.json, nl.json) — Merge by union'; also covers LICENSE/package.json/workflows/custom-* which the with-skill version does not

expectations.text: Uses `--repo zjean/server` on `gh pr create` for the replacement PR
Explicitly reminds the user to use **merge commit** (not squash) when merging the replacement PR
expectations.evidence: 'Merging the replacement PR' section: 'Merge-method dropdown set to "Create a merge commit" — not squash.' Plus `gh pr merge --merge   # NB: --merge, not --squash`
